name: Pastels Boutique
tagline: Lehengas, gowns, anarkalis and co-ord sets
about:
Pastels Boutique is a ladies boutique for lehengas, gowns, anarkalis and co-ord sets in soft and rich colours.
This is a demo catalogue built by OneCatalog to show how a boutique looks in one link. Pick a piece and a size, then tap the WhatsApp button to ask about it.
WhatsApp messages from this demo come to OneCatalog. The address and timings are examples.
metaDescription: Pastels Boutique demo catalogue. Lehengas, gowns, anarkalis and co-ord sets, each with sizes. Enquire on WhatsApp.

categoryIntros.Lehengas: Lehengas in lace, net and printed fabrics, with crop tops, jackets and drapes. Soft shades and rich colours for sangeet, weddings and festivals.
categoryIntros.Gowns: Long gowns for parties and receptions, from a one shoulder ruffle to a saree-style drape. Pick your size and send it on WhatsApp.
categoryIntros.Co-ord and Cape Sets: Co-ord sets and cape tops with skirts. Easy to wear, easy to style, and good for day and evening.
categoryIntros.Kurtis and Kurtas: Kurtis and kurtas with prints, layers, tassels and fine embroidery. Easy to wear every day and good for festivals.
categoryIntros.Anarkalis: Anarkalis with fine gold work and matching dupattas, made for festivals and family functions.
